# Indikator 4a2

Measures the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients with indication for anticoagulation treatment who receive treatment 2 years after index date, with a standard of ≥90% compliance across Danish regions and health clusters.

## Mentions

- Page 30: "Indikator 4a2: Andelen af patienter med atrieflimren, med indikation for antikoagulationsbehandling, der modtager behandling 2 år efter indeksdata" [^src1]

## Relationships

- [[danmark|Danmark]] — measures-compliance-in [^src1]. Evidence: "Indikator 4a2 reports 88,6% compliance for Danmark" (Page 30)

## Claims

- For Indikator 4a2 (2-year anticoagulation treatment), Danmark achieved 88,6% compliance (95% CI: 88,0-89,3) based on 8.083 / 9.119 patients ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[danmark|Danmark]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Region Hovedstaden achieved 86,9% compliance (95% CI: 85,4-88,2) based on 2.025 / 2.331 patients ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Region Sjælland achieved 88,0% compliance (95% CI: 86,2-89,6) based on 1.325 / 1.506 patients ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[sjaelland|Sjælland]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Region Syddanmark achieved 88,3% compliance (95% CI: 86,9-89,5) based on 2.013 / 2.281 patients ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[syddanmark|Syddanmark]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Region Midtjylland achieved 90,4% compliance (95% CI: 89,0-91,6) based on 1.846 / 2.042 patients, meeting the ≥90% standard ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[midtjylland|Midtjylland]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Region Nordjylland achieved 91,1% compliance (95% CI: 89,2-92,9) based on 874 / 959 patients, meeting the ≥90% standard ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[nordjylland|Nordjylland]])
- For Indikator 4a2, Sundhedsklynge Bornholm achieved 93,8% compliance (95% CI: 86,2-98,0) based on 76 / 81 patients, meeting the ≥90% standard ([[indikator-4a2|Indikator 4a2]], [[sundhedsklynge-bornholm|Sundhedsklynge Bornholm]])
